description_en: Queries the tags that are attached to a VPC peering connection
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources接口查询对等连接已经绑定的标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun vpcpeer list-tag-resources --resource-type PeerConnection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Valid value: PeerConnection. This value specifies a VPC peering connection
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。取值：PeerConnection，VPC对等连接
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resources. You can specify up to 20 resource IDs
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You must specify at least ResourceId.N or Tag.N (which consists of Tag.N.Key and Tag.N.Value)
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

参数ResourceId.N或Tag.N（Tag.N.Key与Tag.N.Value）至少输入一个
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

A tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You must specify at least ResourceId.N or Tag.N (which consists of Tag.N.Key and Tag.N.Value)
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持20个标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。


一个标签值最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

参数ResourceId.N或Tag.N（Tag.N.Key与Tag.N.Value）至少输入一个
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50，默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to start the next query. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no subsequent query is to be sent, do not specify this parameter.

To retrieve the next page of results, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from the previous call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。

如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource is deployed. See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the tag.

All (default)

Custom

System
parameters.help_zh:
标签类型。
All(默认值)

Custom

System
parameters.name: category

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If the returned value is empty, no more results are available.

If a value is returned, it is the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TagResources.description_en: A list of the resources and their tags

items.description_en: The details of a resource and its tag

RegionNo.description_en: The region of the requester VPC of the peering connection
RegionNo.description_zh: VPC对等连接发起方的地域

ResourceType.description_en: The type of the resource. Valid value: PeerConnection, which indicates a VPC peering connection
ResourceType.description_zh: 资源类型。取值：PeerConnection，VPC对等连接
